title: AI visibility metric reference
scope: A site-specific reporting vocabulary, not an industry standard or live dataset.

metrics.label: Web impressions
metrics.evidence: An appearance under the selected search report scope
metrics.authority: provider definition with editorial scope notes

metrics.label: Web clicks
metrics.evidence: Clicks under the selected search report scope
metrics.doesNotEstablish: GA4 sessions or isolated AI clicks
metrics.authority: provider definition with editorial scope notes

metrics.label: Web CTR
metrics.definition: 100 × Web clicks / Web impressions; null when impressions = 0
metrics.evidence: Click rate for matching report filters and aggregation
metrics.doesNotEstablish: AI CTR when divided by an AI-only denominator
metrics.authority: provider definition with editorial scope notes

metrics.label: Google AI Search impressions
metrics.report: Search Console / Generative AI performance / Search
metrics.evidence: Recorded exposure in supported Google AI search features
metrics.doesNotEstablish: Additional exposure to add to Web totals, or AI visits
metrics.authority: provider definition with editorial scope notes

metrics.label: AI Assistant sessions
metrics.report: GA4 / Traffic acquisition / Session default channel group
metrics.evidence: Collected sessions from recognized assistant traffic
metrics.doesNotEstablish: Google AI Overviews and AI Mode visits
metrics.authority: provider definition with editorial scope notes

metrics.label: Organic Search sessions
metrics.report: GA4 / Traffic acquisition / Session default channel group
metrics.evidence: Collected organic-search sessions; includes Google AI search traffic
metrics.doesNotEstablish: A separation of AI search from other organic visits
metrics.authority: provider definition with editorial scope notes

metrics.label: Observed answer citations
metrics.report: A saved, manually reviewed answer panel
metrics.definition: Count observations containing a verified link to the target URL
metrics.evidence: Citation within the recorded prompts, surface, date, and model settings
metrics.doesNotEstablish: All-market share, all prompts, or a site visit

metrics.label: Resource requests
metrics.definition: Count matching method, path, period, and verified identity rule
metrics.evidence: A recorded request for a resource
metrics.doesNotEstablish: A unique human, a citation, or agent identity from user-agent text alone

metrics.label: Qualified inquiries
metrics.definition: Count unique inquiries meeting written fit criteria
metrics.evidence: A verified outcome under the stated review rule
metrics.doesNotEstablish: Revenue, incremental effect, or attribution to an unobserved source

metrics.label: Planned search clicks
metrics.doesNotEstablish: A ranking forecast or measured audience growth

rules: Unknown values are null, not zero.
Do not add impressions, clicks, sessions, requests, citations, or inquiries together.
Combine a numerator and denominator only when scope, dates, filters, and aggregation match.
Never calculate AI CTR from overall Web clicks and AI impressions.
Do not infer all-audience trends from a fixed prompt panel.

exampleObservation.evidenceReference: Replace with your own saved report
